parent_objective: audit M2295 failure-slice diagnosis and select the next non-ranking repair or synthesis route
blocked_by: M2295 recommends offtrack-primary collision-guardrail result audit
supersedes: direct broad repair from global M2293 result
direct profile ranking from diagnostic slices

public_gates: M2296 must not rerun environment reset or rollout
M2296 must verify M2295 count reproduction and route recommendation
M2296 must decide whether offtrack containment, collision guardrail, scenario-task reshaping, or synthesis is the next route
M2296 must not rank profiles, select a winner, or claim paper/self-ID evidence
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits artifact-only failure slices and selects the next route after M2293/M2295 evidence
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit and route selection only; no rollout ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if M2295 count reproduction is invalid
stop if M2295 route recommendation is unsupported by slices
stop if audit would rank profiles or select a winner
stop if no non-ranking follow-up route can be selected
fallback_plan: route to artifact repair if M2295 counts are invalid
route to offtrack-primary collision-guardrail design if slices support it
route to scenario-task reshaping if slices indicate task quality is the blocker
route to synthesis if slices remain too diffuse
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2295 writes failure-slice diagnosis and route recommendation

training_stage.stage_objective: audit failure-slice diagnosis and choose next non-ranking route
allowed_updates: M2296 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by audit
next_stage_criteria: M2295 count reproduction is accepted or rejected
route recommendation is accepted or corrected

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2296 audits failure slices but does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No wrong-history, reset-hidden, or zero-history intervention is run in M2296.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Treat failure-slice conclusions as task-performance diagnosis, not self-ID evidence.

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: turns slice diagnosis into an explicit next-route decision before repair
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can decide whether the current-sim route needs offtrack containment, collision guardrail, or scenario reshaping
must_synthesize_if: M2296 cannot select a non-ranking route
M2296 recommends another broad repair without slice support
M2296 repeats M2294/M2295 without narrowing the route

hypothesis: M2295 failure-slice diagnosis can be audited to choose an offtrack-primary collision-guardrail next route without rerun, ranking, or paper/self-ID claims.
success_criteria: M2295 primary route is accepted or corrected
a non-ranking follow-up route is pre-registered
failure_criteria: M2296 ranks profiles or selects a winner
M2296 changes scenario specs or profile configs
M2296 makes paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 self-ID claims
M2296 cannot select a next route

commands.name: audit
commands.command: manual result audit over runs/m2295_paper_route_current_sim_scenario_task_family_failure_slice_diagnosis/summary.json and dominant_slices.csv

decision_rule: M2296 passes if it verifies M2295 diagnosis and pre-registers a non-ranking follow-up route.
